title: critiplotR: Visualize Risk-of-Bias Assessments with 'critiplot'
description:
critiplotR is an R interface to the Python package critiplot. It creates publication-ready traffic-light plots and stacked bar charts for risk-of-bias assessments in systematic reviews and meta-analyses, supporting the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS), the JBI critical appraisal checklists for case reports and case series, GRADE certainty of evidence, ROBIS, and the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT).

Plots are produced by critiplot through the reticulate package. Documentation is available at https://critiplot.github.io/critiplotR/.
